english.title: Personal licence holder fail to give licensing authority notice of requirement to pay an immigration penalty
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a personal licence under the Licensing Act 2003 and being required to pay an immigration penalty, failed, without reasonable excuse and as soon as reasonably practicable, to give the relevant licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..), a notice containing details of the penalty, including the date of the notice by which the penalty was imposed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 132(2B), (4) and (5) of the Licensing Act 2003
